program.title: BBA in Operations Management
uncertain: total_required_credits (20.0) is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all non-optional groups (4 + 4 + 12).
The OM Elective requirement is open-ended (any qualifying ISOM course); the PDF provides no fixed course list for the general case, so the courses array is empty.
The two Options (Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management) are optional and excluded from total_required_credits.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 OM (4Y) (2026-27 intake)', i.e. the 2026-27 intake curriculum.

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: ISOM OM Electives: any 4 ISOM courses coded between 3500 and 3999 (except ISOM 3780) and 4500 to 4999, totaling 12 credits. Students taking the Business Analytics Option can only use courses in the specified elective list. Courses taken as Option Required Courses may not be counted towards this elective requirement. The PDF lists a restricted list for the Business Analytics option (ISOM 3530, 3540, 4520, 4530, 4540, 4720, 4740, 4780, 4810, 4830, 4860, 4880) but the general OM electives are open-ended (any qualifying ISOM course); the courses array is empty for the open-ended requirement.

groups.name: Business Analytics Option Required Course(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL. 2 courses: ISOM 3360 and ISOM 3900. These also count toward the OM Electives requirement. Not counted in total_required_credits.

groups.name: Supply Chain Management Option Required Course(s)
groups.note: OPTIONAL. 2 courses: ISOM 3760 and ISOM 3770. Not counted in total_required_credits.
